steps.title: 1. Game Mode & Heat System
steps.description: Step 1: Choose Pact of Punishment heat handling and room check clearing mechanics

items.title: 🔄 Reverse Heat (Default)
items.desc: Start with high pacts of punishment; find pact reduction items in the multiworld.

items.title: 🔥 Minimal Heat
items.desc: Start with high pacts that can never be reduced. For true Underworld masochists.

items.title: ⚔️ Vanilla Heat
items.desc: Standard Hades heat mechanics without randomized pact reduction items.

options.name: Room Based (Clearing any room at depth gives a check once)
Score Based (Accumulate depth score to unlock milestone checks)
Room Weapon Based (Clearing rooms with each specific weapon yields checks)

controls.label: Auto-Collect Room Checks on Hades Defeat (Instantly rewards remaining room checks upon clearing the run)

steps.title: 2. Sanity Checks & Pools
steps.description: Step 2: Choose which Underworld collectibles, weapons, and systems are randomized into the multiworld

controls.label: Weaponsanity (Infernal Arms are randomized items; unlocking in Skelly's room is a check)
Hidden Aspectsanity (Hidden weapon aspects must be unlocked in the multiworld)
Keepsakesanity (Olympian & Chthonic keepsakes are randomized items in the multiworld)
MirrorSanity (Mirror of Night talent upgrades are randomized items)
FateSanity (Fated List of Minor Prophecies tasks are location checks)
StoreSanity (Important House Contractor items are randomized in the pool)
FishSanity (Catching each Underworld fish for the first time is a location check)
TroveSanity (Infernal Trove challenges in each biome act as location checks)

steps.title: 3. DeathLink & Balancing
steps.description: Step 3: Configure multiworld death consequences, amnesty counter, and boss modifiers

controls.label: Enable DeathLink (Zagreus deaths broadcast to the multiworld and vice versa)
DeathLink Amnesty (Deaths required before broadcasting a DeathLink):
Ignore Greece Deaths (Story deaths on the surface will not trigger DeathLink)
Reverse Order Extreme Measures (Extreme Measures 1 applies to Hades instead of the Furies for smoother scaling)
